name.zh: 加利福尼亚 89 号州道

aka.en: Emerald Bay Road (Lake Tahoe west shore)
Lassen Park Highway (through Lassen Volcanic National Park)
aka.zh: 拉森公园公路（穿越拉森火山国家公园）

tagline.en: A mountain road the length of the northern Sierra and southern Cascades, from Monitor Pass past Lake Tahoe and Lassen Peak to Mount Shasta
tagline.zh: 一条纵贯北内华达山脉与南喀斯喀特山脉的山路，从蒙尼特山口经太浩湖与拉森峰直到沙斯塔山

start.en: I-5 at Mount Shasta, Siskiyou County
start.zh: 锡斯基尤县芒特沙斯塔，与 I-5 相接

end.en: US 395 near Coleville, Mono County, at the foot of Monitor Pass
end.zh: 莫诺县科尔维尔附近，蒙尼特山口脚下，与 US 395 相接

en: CA 89 is almost entirely a two-lane mountain road, and it strings together some of the best-known scenery in northern California. From US 395 in the Great Basin it climbs over Monitor Pass to Markleeville, shares Route 88 past Woodfords, crosses Luther Pass and meets US 50 at Meyers. It then follows the west shore of Lake Tahoe on a narrow shelf above Emerald Bay to Tahoe City, and runs down the Truckee River to Truckee and I-80.

North of Truckee it crosses Sierra Valley and the Feather River country by Sierraville, Graeagle and Quincy to Lake Almanor, then passes through Lassen Volcanic National Park as the park's main road, round the flank of Lassen Peak. Beyond the park it runs through the forests by Burney Falls and McCloud to end at I-5 below Mount Shasta.

Snow shapes it. Monitor Pass and the Lassen park road close for the winter, and the Emerald Bay section is often shut by storms and avalanche danger, while summer brings Tahoe's heaviest congestion to the junction with Route 28 at Tahoe City.
zh: CA 89 几乎全程都是双车道山路，把北加州许多最著名的景色串在一起。它从大盆地中的 US 395 出发，翻越蒙尼特山口到马克利维尔，经伍德福兹与 88 号州道共线，越过路德山口，在梅耶斯与 US 50 相接。随后它沿太浩湖西岸，经翡翠湾上方一条狭窄的山崖路到太浩城，再顺特拉基河而下到特拉基与 I-80。
特拉基以北，它穿过塞拉谷与费瑟河一带，经塞拉维尔、格雷格尔与昆西到阿尔马诺湖，再作为拉森火山国家公园的主干道穿过公园，绕行拉森峰山腰。出了公园，它穿过伯尼瀑布与麦克劳德一带的森林，止于沙斯塔山下的 I-5。
积雪塑造了这条路。蒙尼特山口与拉森公园公路冬季封闭，翡翠湾一段也常因风暴与雪崩危险而关闭；夏季，太浩湖最严重的拥堵则出现在太浩城与 28 号州道的交汇处。

en: Most of the route was defined as state highway in 1911, as Legislative Routes 23 and 38, and the section from US 395 to Markleeville in 1926. It was signed as Route 89 in 1934 from US 395 near Coleville to US 99, now I-5, near Mount Shasta, by way of Truckee, Quincy and Chester. The Monitor Pass section, although funded in 1926, does not appear as built on state maps until 1953, and was not signed as Route 89 until 1957. Through Lassen park the road was built by the National Park Service and completed in 1931.

Emerald Bay produced the route's biggest fight. Late in 1955 a rock and earth slide carried the road down to the bay and closed it for eleven months. The state Division of Highways then planned a bridge across the mouth of the bay, with a scale model and a watercolour to sell it; The Sacramento Bee called it “a tragic mistake bordering on a crime”. The debate ran into the mid-1960s, until the new Tahoe regional planning body left the bridge out of its first plan in 1968 and a state committee shelved it. In 1969 Emerald Bay was designated a National Natural Landmark.

Freeway routings adopted in 1963 were rescinded in 1974 for lack of money, and the road kept its two-lane form. In 1986 the Legislature transferred the section shared with Route 88 between Woodfords and Picketts Junction to Route 88, so that Route 89 is legally split there, though it is still signed through. At Truckee the 1928 railway underpass known as the Mousehole still narrows the highway to one lane each way; a separate tunnel for walkers and cyclists, the mini Mousehole, was pushed under the tracks and opened in 2016.
zh: 路线大部分于 1911 年作为第 23 号与第 38 号法定路线列为州公路，US 395 至马克利维尔一段则于 1926 年列入。1934 年，它被标为 89 号州道，自科尔维尔附近的 US 395 经特拉基、昆西与切斯特，至芒特沙斯塔附近的 US 99（今 I-5）。蒙尼特山口一段虽于 1926 年获得拨款，但直到 1953 年才在州地图上显示为已建成，1957 年才标为 89 号州道。穿越拉森公园的道路由国家公园管理局修建，1931 年完工。
翡翠湾引发了这条路最大的一场争论。1955 年末，一场岩土滑坡把道路冲下湖湾，封路达 11 个月。州公路局随后计划在湖湾口修建一座大桥，还制作了比例模型和水彩画来推销；《萨克拉门托蜂报》称其为“近乎犯罪的悲剧性错误”。争论一直持续到 1960 年代中期，直到新成立的太浩地区规划机构在 1968 年的首份规划中没有纳入这座桥，州里的一个委员会随后将其搁置。1969 年，翡翠湾被列为国家自然地标。

1963 年选定的高速公路线位，于 1974 年因缺乏资金而撤销，这条路保持了双车道的形态。1986 年，州议会将伍德福兹至皮克茨交叉口之间与 88 号州道共线的一段划归 88 号州道，使 89 号州道在法律上于此处断开，但标志上仍连续标示。在特拉基，1928 年建成、人称“老鼠洞”的铁路下穿通道至今仍把公路收窄为单向一车道；一条供行人与自行车使用的独立隧道——“小老鼠洞”——以顶推方式穿过铁轨下方，于 2016 年启用。

en: Around Lake Tahoe the route's money goes into the lake as much as the road. Caltrans has rebuilt the west-shore highway in sections under the multi-agency Lake Tahoe Environmental Improvement Program to collect and treat stormwater before it reaches the lake: a $70.1 million project between Tahoma and Tahoe City and a $24.4 million one from the US 50 junction at South Lake Tahoe to Cascade Road were both under way in 2016.

At Tahoe City the realignment that takes the highway off the old Fanny Bridge over the Truckee River was estimated at $38.877 million, funded by $30.62 million from the Federal Lands Access Program, $4.9 million from the state Active Transportation Program and $3.357 million in local money. The mini Mousehole at Truckee cost more than $13 million, from federal, state and local sources, after about twenty years from idea to opening.
zh: 在太浩湖一带，这条路的钱既花在路上，也花在湖里。加州交通局在多机构合作的“太浩湖环境改善计划”下分段改建西岸公路，以便在雨水流入湖中之前将其收集处理：太浩马至太浩城之间一项 7,010 万美元的工程，以及南太浩湖 US 50 交汇处至卡斯凯德路之间一项 2,440 万美元的工程，2016 年均在施工。
在太浩城，使公路改道、不再经过特拉基河上旧范妮桥的工程估算为 3,887.7 万美元，资金来自联邦“联邦土地通达计划”的 3,062 万美元、州“主动交通计划”的 490 万美元及 335.7 万美元地方资金。特拉基的“小老鼠洞”从构想到启用历时约二十年，造价逾 1,300 万美元，资金来自联邦、州与地方。

why.en: No figure exists for the route. It was assembled from 1911 and 1926 legislative routes built by the state and, through Lassen park, by the National Park Service, and has been improved project by project since.
why.zh: 全线并无造价数据。它由 1911 年与 1926 年的法定路线拼成，由州政府修建，拉森公园段则由国家公园管理局修建，此后逐个项目改善。

why.en: There is no single funder. Caltrans maintains the state sections with state and federal-aid money, the National Park Service the road through Lassen park, and Tahoe projects draw on federal lands, environmental and local funds as well.
why.zh: 没有单一出资方。加州交通局以州资金与联邦补助资金养护州属路段，国家公园管理局负责拉森公园内的道路，太浩湖一带的项目还动用联邦土地、环境及地方资金。

timeline.en: Most of the route is defined as state highway, as Legislative Routes 23 and 38.
timeline.zh: 路线大部分作为第 23 号与第 38 号法定路线列为州公路。

timeline.en: The Monitor Pass section from US 395 to Markleeville is added and funded.
timeline.zh: US 395 至马克利维尔的蒙尼特山口段被列入并获拨款。

timeline.en: The road through Lassen Volcanic National Park is completed.
timeline.zh: 穿越拉森火山国家公园的道路完工。

timeline.en: Route 89 is signed from Coleville to Mount Shasta.
timeline.zh: 89 号州道自科尔维尔至芒特沙斯塔设立标志。

timeline.en: A slide late in the year closes the road at Emerald Bay for eleven months.
timeline.zh: 年末一场滑坡使翡翠湾段封闭 11 个月。

timeline.en: The Monitor Pass section is signed as Route 89.
timeline.zh: 蒙尼特山口段标为 89 号州道。

timeline.en: Emerald Bay becomes a National Natural Landmark after the bridge plan is shelved.
timeline.zh: 大桥计划搁置后，翡翠湾被列为国家自然地标。

timeline.en: Freeway routings adopted in 1963 are rescinded.
timeline.zh: 1963 年选定的高速公路线位被撤销。

timeline.en: The Woodfords–Picketts Junction section is transferred to Route 88.
timeline.zh: 伍德福兹至皮克茨交叉口段划归 88 号州道。

timeline.en: The mini Mousehole opens at Truckee.
timeline.zh: 特拉基的“小老鼠洞”启用。
